model: Buzzaround XL GB117 (3-wheel; GB147 is the 4-wheel version)
notes: Covers GB117, GB117S, GB147 and GB147S (S = suspension versions).

gaps: Battery size conflicts: the owner's manual spec table gives 2-12 AH or 2-20 AH (and lists a '20 AMP Battery Pack' accessory), while the service guide says two 12AH or two 22AH batteries.
The 30-40 A rating for the R50 is said to fit the 30 A breaker here.
The exact DR50 variant in this scooter is not stated.
These are test readings, not charger ratings.
No motor wattage or charger current is stated in either document.
method: Two Golden Technologies documents for GB117/GB147 were read as text, both from copies on a retailer's Shopify CDN (the host store was not identified).
Both are Golden's own documents, with Golden's title page, Old Forge PA address and document codes.

(1) Buzzaround XL Service Guide (page header Buzzaround XL_SG_REVA; back cover code BUZZAROUND XL_SERVMAN_REVA_110915, and the back cover also pictures GB117S/GB147S): a component-by-component list with ratings, locations and test values.
Golden's own owner's-manuals page links only to a Dropbox folder that could not be read, so the Shopify copies are cited.
The owner's manual says to use only AGM or gel-cell SLA deep-cycle batteries.
The service guide places the controller on the front frame under the floor shroud and lists its connections: main harness, charger and inhibit, brake, motor M1/M2, battery B-/B+.
The owner's manual spec table gives the controller as 50 Amp, Dynamic R-Series.
Dynamic Controls' R-series installation manual (linked as a datasheet) lists DR50-A01/DR50-B01 as its R-series 50 A controllers.
For the DR50 it gives 14 A continuous, 40 A peak and 50 A boosted current, a 4-6 kOhm throttle, and a 30-40 A fuse or breaker rating for the R50.
The service guide gives the system voltage as 18-24 V DC and an approx. 27 V full battery reading, rising to about 29.5 V with the charger running.

comps.spec: Two 12 V batteries wired in series for 24 V DC through the circuit breaker, inside the removable battery pack; two 12 Ah or two 22 Ah per the service guide
Drive motor, part of the motor/brake assembly mounted on the transaxle (serviced by replacing that assembly); internal motor resistance 0.8-1.5 ohm
Brake mounted on the end of the motor, holds the motor still when power is off; brake resistance 45-52 ohm; replaced as part of the motor/brake assembly
Controller: Dynamic R-Series, 50 Amp (spec table, GB117 and GB147)
30 A circuit breaker connected between the two batteries (both leads orange); replace only with one of the same current rating
40 A inline battery fuse in the battery harness
5 A inline charger fuse in the battery harness, protects the charging circuit
Throttle pot on a three-wire connector (yellow, white, orange), 5 kOhm +/-10% across the two outer wires; connected to the main harness and a 1 A in-line fuse
Speed pot, controls scooter speed by variable resistance; replaceable on its own
Off-board battery charger; plugs into the charger port on the battery pack or on the tiller
comps.loc: Stored in a pouch on the seat back

comps.spec: LED headlight, standard, with on/off switch on the right side of the tiller
